provenance.title: Switch placement
provenance.covers: Where a light switch goes next to a door and how high. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A light switch sits beside the door on the wall, a little way from the frame, at hand height.
